learning_objective: 🎯 Find the 'center of gravity' of your data! Master the art of calculating the Mean, Median, and Mode to summarize massive datasets into a single representative number.

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति (वह केंद्रीय मूल्य जो पूरे आंकड़ों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है)
समांतर माध्य (आंकड़ों का औसत = योग / कुल संख्या)
माध्यिका (आंकड़ों को क्रम में रखने पर बिल्कुल बीच का मूल्य)
बहुलक (वह मूल्य जो आंकड़ों में सबसे अधिक बार आता है)
चतुर्थक (वह मूल्य जो आंकड़ों को चार बराबर भागों में बांटता है)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: An average reduces millions of numbers into one single representative figure. It allows us to compare different groups (e.g., the average income of India vs. the USA) and helps in decision-making.
The most common average. Calculated by adding all the values and dividing by the number of observations. Formula: X̄ = ΣX / N. It is heavily affected by extreme values (outliers).

Arrange the data in ascending or descending order. The Median is the exact middle number. It splits the data into two equal halves (50% above, 50% below). Unlike the Mean, it is NOT affected by extreme values.
Just like the median divides data into 2 parts, Quartiles divide data into 4 equal parts (Q1, Q2, Q3 - where Q2 is the median), Deciles into 10 parts, and Percentiles into 100 equal parts.
The value that occurs most frequently in a dataset. It is the most 'popular' item. In some cases, a dataset might have two modes (bimodal) or no mode at all if every number appears only once.

fun_activity.title: ⚖️ The Outlier Effect
fun_activity.instructions: Take the ages of 5 friends: 15, 16, 15, 17, 16. The Mean is 15.8. Now, imagine a 90-year-old grandfather joins the group. The ages are: 15, 15, 16, 16, 17, 90. The new Mean shoots up to 28.1! This shows how 'Outliers' drag the Arithmetic Mean, making it a bad representative in unequal groups. (The Median, however, stays at 16!).

exam_tips: 📌 In a continuous series, the Median class is found using the (N/2)th item, and the exact median is calculated using the formula: L + [(N/2 - c.f.) / f] × i.
📌 The empirical relationship between the three averages in an asymmetrical distribution is: Mode = 3 Median - 2 Mean.
📌 The sum of deviations of the items from their arithmetic mean is ALWAYS zero: Σ(X - X̄) = 0.
quick_recap: ⭐ The Mean is a mathematical average, while the Median and Mode are positional averages.
⭐ To calculate the Median, the data MUST first be arranged in ascending or descending order.
⭐ A weighted arithmetic mean gives different importance/weights to different items (e.g., calculating a GPA where subjects have different credit hours).
